seven_fields.name: 1 canonical object and observation relation with an exact scalar type
2 concrete entry points and source identity on each side
3 representation invariant established by the actual constructor
4 separate Rust and Song admission predicates
5 success / unsupported-input / resource-exhaustion behaviour with raw return encoding and post-state
6 separate Rust and Song resource accounting
7 source-connected refinement and a rejecting control

canonical.object: The merge parameter f : V -> V -> V of Apeiron.Table.HMap; the arithmetic merge is commutative-ring addition on the scalar. Canonical observation: reading a built table at a key is a fold of f over that key's values in stream order.
canonical.observation_relation: Apeiron.Table.get (Apeiron.Table.build f d kvs) x = ((kvs.filter (fun kv => kv.1 = x)).map Prod.snd).foldl (fun acc v => f v acc) d (get_build_acc); schedule freedom under hcomm and hassoc (build_gauge_invariance).
canonical.scalar_type: Rust i64, wrapping Z/2^64 (Ring::add = i64::wrapping_add); Song mergeAcc(left, right) = left + right on bounded machine integers with 0 <= left, right <= COORD_CEILING; canonical scalar ZMod (2^64) under denote.

rust.role: the scalar trait whose i64 instance is wrapping

song.role: pure accumulator merge with in-tree comm/assoc laws
executing MERGE_ACC arm computes oldVal + value inline

representation_invariant.constructor: src/table.rs::WordMerge (impl Merge<i64> for WordMerge) and src/scalar.rs impl Ring for i64; Song mergeAcc and the MERGE_ACC arm of tableInsertWith.
representation_invariant.statement: A scalar is its i64 bit pattern. Rust wrapping add denotes addition in ZMod (2^64). Song mergeAcc(left, right) = left + right is that same addition on the matched bounded domain 0 <= v <= COORD_CEILING. Rust WordMerge and the Song inline oldVal + value are the canonical merge f only when the two additions agree on the matched domain; that agreement is not yet proved for the Song side.

rust.predicate: The merge admits every (i64, i64); Ring::add is total wrapping. There is no merge-level refusal; admission is inherited from the table write (insert_with).

song.predicate: mergeAcc admits every pair. The MERGE_ACC arm of tableInsertWith is reached only when tableCapacityOk(cap) is nonzero, key is not TABLE_EMPTY (-1), and merge is in MERGE_SET..MERGE_ACC. mergeAcc's law givens require 0 <= left, right <= COORD_CEILING; the inline arm carries no such guard.

behavior.success: Rust WordMerge::merge(new, old) = new.wrapping_add(old). Song MERGE_ACC writes oldVal + value into the slot and returns the new value.
behavior.unsupported_input: Rust: none at the merge; every pair is defined. Song: none at mergeAcc; a value outside 0..COORD_CEILING is outside the matched domain (the inline arm still computes).
behavior.resource_exhaustion: Not applicable at the merge: one addition either fits the word or wraps. There is no merge-level refusal.
behavior.raw_return_encoding: Rust an i64 word (wrapping). Song an i64-width word returned through tableSlotValSet; no separate success tag.
behavior.post_state: Rust merge is pure (Merge::merge(&self, new, old) -> V). Song MERGE_ACC writes the merged value into the slot; mergeAcc alone is pure.

rust.accounting: one wrapping addition per merge call

song.accounting: one addition in mergeAcc; the MERGE_ACC arm computes oldVal + value inline

refinement.source_connected: Rust side: proof/Denotation.lean::denote_wrapping_add proves the wrapping word addition is ZMod (2^64) addition. The extracted WordMerge has no dedicated bridge theorem yet, so the Rust merge is source-connected to the canonical addition only through denote_wrapping_add, not through a table-level refinement. Song side: mergeacc_comm and mergeacc_assoc are in-tree Song laws, not canonical Lean, and no checked Song-to-Lean refinement exists. The joint refinement is OPEN.
refinement.rejecting_control: Change the Rust merge body from new.wrapping_add(old) to new.wrapping_sub(old) in a throwaway copy of src/table.rs, re-extract, and proof/regen.sh --check fails on the generated-body diff; restoring passes. This is an extraction-drift control; the semantic Song refinement remains the open obligation.

canonical.object: Apeiron.Table.HMap K V := K -> V with get, insertWith f k v m := fun x => if x = k then f v (m x) else m x, and build f d kvs.
canonical.observation_relation: get (insertWith f k v m) k = f v (m k) and get (insertWith f k v m) x = get m x for x != k; a built table reads as a per-key fold (get_build_acc).
canonical.scalar_type: Word instance Table I64 I64 WordHome 16: keys and values i64, denotation I64 -> ZMod (2^64); the physical home is home(key) mod 256.

song.role: probe for a key, returning slot or -1
probe for empty slot or matching key

representation_invariant.constructor: Rust Table::new(default, home) sets shards = [None; 256] and stores default; Song tableInit / tableInitGo writes key TABLE_EMPTY and value 0 into every slot.
representation_invariant.statement: Rust Rep(t, h): the fixed outer [Option<[Option<(K,V)>; N]>; 256], an untouched shard is None, globally unique keys, every entry in its home shard home(k) mod 256, and forall k, D(t)(k) = h(k) with D the matching override or the stored default. The Rust constructor establishes Rep(t, fun _ => d) at N = 16 (word_table_new_rep); the general-N clause is open. Song invariant: memory[base + 2*slot] is the key (TABLE_EMPTY = -1 for empty) and memory[base + 2*slot + 1] the value; tableInit establishes the all-empty state. No Song Rep theorem exists.

rust.predicate: insert_with refuses with StorageError::ShardFull exactly when the key is absent and its home shard has no vacant slot; N = 0 refuses every write; reads are total; build refuses at the first refused insertion. Refusal invokes neither clone nor merge and changes no field.

song.predicate: tableInsertWith returns TABLE_EMPTY = -1 when tableCapacityOk(cap) is 0, when key is TABLE_EMPTY (-1), when the merge code is outside MERGE_SET..MERGE_ACC, or when tableFindSlotGo exhausts the cap probes. tableGet and tableFind return -1 for a missing key.

behavior.success: Rust: Ok(()) with an existing key updating stored = merge(value, stored.clone()) and a new key inserting merge(value, default.clone()) in the home shard. Song: returns the merged value, updating the slot for an existing key or filling the first empty probe slot for a new key (TABLE_PRESENT = 1 under MERGE_SET).
behavior.unsupported_input: Rust: N = 0 write. Song: non-positive or non-power-of-two cap; key -1 (reserved); merge code outside 1..3.
behavior.resource_exhaustion: Rust: ShardFull when the home shard holds N absent-key entries. Song: -1 when all cap probes are occupied (no empty slot). The capacities are different and the refusals need not coincide.
behavior.raw_return_encoding: Rust Result<(), StorageError>, StorageError::ShardFull; reads return &V. Song a raw word: -1 (TABLE_EMPTY) is overloaded across missing read, empty slot, invalid capacity, reserved key, invalid merge code and full table; a successful MERGE_SET write returns 1 (TABLE_PRESENT). Therefore -1 is not a reliable success/refusal tag (H1).
behavior.post_state: Rust refusal changes no field (word_table_shardFull_refusal at N = 16); success preserves the canonical insertWith denotation (open for arbitrary N). Song writes in place, so a mid-stream full table leaves earlier writes in place (H3); tableInit returns -1 on invalid capacity without writing.

up to cap steps of tableLookupSlotGo / tableFindSlotGo, measure cap - step

recursion depth bounded by cap probes, measure cap - step

refinement.source_connected: Rust side: proof/corpus/TableRefinement.lean proves word_table_new_rep, word_table_get_new_first, word_table_get_replaced, word_table_build_get_acc and word_table_shardFull_refusal against Apeiron.Table at the concrete N = 16 word instance; Rep there is read-only extensional and universal Rep / admission completeness is open. Song side: no checked Song-to-Lean refinement of tableInit, tableFind, tableGet or tableInsertWith exists. The joint row is OPEN and is the first joint storage target.
refinement.rejecting_control: Same-filesystem throwaway generated-body mutation merge value default -> merge default value fails table_insert_empty_zero (recorded in proof/README.md); restoring builds. This controls the Rust fresh-write denotation only and does not control the Song side.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Rust src/cell.rs::{mul, norm_form} (with add, channels and idempotents) over Ring; Song side NONE.
unmatched_blockers.reason: Song has no executing two-slot algebra with a Sigma dial. song/src/prover/ring/prover0.slang operates on SKI/iota terms, not on R[x]/(x^2 - sigma) cells, so there is no matched domain.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Rust src/carrier.rs::{point_density, point_flux, conservative_density_step, diffusive_flux_half, diffusive_line3_step}; Song side NONE.
unmatched_blockers.reason: No Song executing primitive denotes the carrier readout or the exact integer carrier update.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Rust src/exchange.rs::{exchange_impulse, elastic_exchange, accept_derived_impulse}; Song side NONE.
unmatched_blockers.reason: No Song executing primitive performs the equal-mass exchange or the checked-claim acceptance.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Song song/src/prover/ring/prover0.slang::{verdict, normalize, pass, structEq}; Rust side NONE.
unmatched_blockers.reason: There is no executing Rust evaluator for the canonical Apeiron.Combinator semantics, so the Song prover has no Rust counterpart to relate to.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Song song/src/prover/cone/certcheck.slang::{main, ccBatch, ccRun}; Rust side NONE.
unmatched_blockers.reason: There is no Rust decider. certcheck must refine Apeiron.Decider.checkCert and checkCert_sound; that refinement is not established.

unmatched_blockers.counterpart: Rust src/table.rs::Table::build is transactional (Result<Self, StorageError>, no partial table); Song has only per-insert tableInsertWith plus tableInit and no transactional build.
unmatched_blockers.reason: Song's insertion loop is not Rust's transactional build: a refused insertion leaves earlier writes in place. The composition obligation is to define a matched Song build whose refusal post-state is the empty table, or to restrict the admitted domain.

hazards.statement: Song reserves key -1 (TABLE_EMPTY) and returns -1 for a missing read, while Rust has no reserved key and returns the stored default.
hazards.consequence: Song's raw return is not a reliable success/refusal tag: -1 conflates missing read, empty slot, invalid capacity, reserved key, invalid merge code and full table.

hazards.statement: Rust default is a stored value returned for any unwritten key; Song tableGet returns -1 for a missing key and has no stored default.
hazards.consequence: The canonical HMap total default is not represented by Song's missing-read. The matched domain must fix the default and exclude the reserved key, or the correspondence is false at absent keys.

hazards.statement: Song tableInsertWith mutates slots in place; Rust build returns Err at the first refused insertion with no partial table.
hazards.consequence: Song's multi-insert is not transactional; a mid-stream full table leaves partial writes. This is the B6 composition obligation, not a shared semantics.

hazards.statement: Canonical I is S K K, while Song treats primitive i (TAG_I) and the normal form **skk as distinct (distinct_atoms, tag difference).
hazards.consequence: A regression fixture must pin the distinction; it is not something to patch away by conflating the primitive and the normal form.

hazards.statement: Song certcheck must refine Apeiron.Decider.checkCert and checkCert_sound.
hazards.consequence: Until that refinement exists, Song's UNSAT replay is not the canonical checker and carries its own in-tree soundness only.

integration_order: R1 word arithmetic: fix the matched scalar domain (0 <= v <= COORD_CEILING, key -1 excluded) and the shared addition observation.
R2 table init/read/write: the first joint storage target; define the matched admission relation and a Song Rep invariant.
B6 table build composition: define a transactional Song build or restrict the admitted domain.
B1..B5 unmatched counterparts, in dependency order: cell algebra, carrier, exchange, combinator evaluator, certificate replayer.
Vertical lift/reduction demonstration only after the profile and the executing evaluator refinement.
not_covered: rustc/LLVM code generation and the generated machine code.
The kernel ABI, stack and OS.
Runtime linkage between Apeiron and Song; the required result is a checked correspondence, not linkage.
Song local registers, ontology and commands.
Semantic correspondence itself: the checker establishes specification consistency only.
Arbitrary-N Rust Rep preservation and admission completeness.
Song-to-Lean refinement for R1 and R2.
